company.shortDescription: Archform is making the next generation of clear aligners enabled by powerful by 3D software and 3D printing.
company.description: ArchForm enables doctors to 3D print in-office so that they can start treatment during their first appointment. ArchForm also manufactures aligners for orthodontists using robotics to drastically reduce the price compared to traditional aligners.

aiResearchSummary.text: ArchForm is researching design and manufacture of orthodontic appliances using a user interface that displays models of teeth and palates to define non-moveable zones, enabling precise design of dental appliances. Work on fabrication of dental appliances via rapid prototyping forms aligners from olefin polymers without intermediary molds. They also develop unibody orthodontic appliances and appliances to cause intrusion of posterior teeth. Overall, they focus on digital design, direct fabrication, and functional clear aligner systems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $7,842,080, or 98.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,577,641 to $40,775,463, a 15.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
